entries.en: Thank you, Shepard. I knew you were the right man for the job.
Thank you, Shepard. I knew you were the right woman for the job.
Come back and see me when the job is done.
You are the only one I can turn to, Shepard! Besides, I have already transmitted the coordinates to your ship.
Please, just see what you can do. I will be waiting here when you're done.
So the truth comes out. I hope you are not angry. Surely you can understand why I lied to you?
No need to raise your voice, Commander. Surely you can understand why I lied to you?
If people found out my sister was a criminal, I'd be considered a security risk. They'd revoke my clearance, or place me on administrative leave until she was apprehended.
That is why I misled you. I could not risk you exposing me. But now that Dahlia is out of the picture, it is no longer a problem.
Perhaps you are right. I am sorry. We have trust issues in my family.
I am sorry I wasn't honest with you. We have trust issues in my family.
I could not agree more. She was my sister, but I will not shed any tears for her death.
I shall transfer a little something into your account as a token of my appreciation. I'm sure you will find the amount satisfactory.
You make a good point. Anyone can come up with credits. But I can give you authorization to purchase prototype asari mods.
True, but I am the only one who can authorize you to purchase prototype asari mods.
I will get you added to our manufacturer's preferred client list. I think you would be very interested in what they have available.
Goodbye, Shepard. It has been a pleasure doing business with you.
I do not like being in anyone's debt. Consider it a fee for doing your civic duty if it makes you feel any better.
Or give it away to some charity. I care not. The funds are already on their way. They are your problem now.
Understood, Shepard. I will not bother you again.
I am not that stupid. You will get a fair deal. A very fair deal.
Goodbye, Shepard.
I do not want to take chances with my sister's life. I need a Spectre.
Besides, you operate outside official channels. My superiors cannot find out I never reported the ransom in the first place.
I have resources. Contacts and credits can go a long way, especially if you are willing to bend the rules.
I already broke the law when I paid the ransom. This couldn't make things any worse.
Pretty much what you'd expect: rough, dangerous, and well-armed. Nothing a Spectre cannot handle, though.
Is there something I can do for you?
What? Are you saying she's...
I gave you what you wanted, Shepard. We have nothing more to discuss.
Thank you for all your help, Shepard.
I don't have time to talk now. I'm very busy.
Keep your reward. I'll bring your sister back. I promise.
Don't worry. I'll bring your sister back.
I've got more important things to do than track down your sister.
I would've helped if you'd just told me the truth.
Do your own dirty work next time!
Your sister was a slaver. She got what was coming to her.
You're a diplomat on her way up the ranks. It could be handy to have a Spectre who owes you a favor.
I'm a Spectre, not some merc for hire. I can find credits anywhere.
I don't want your blood money.
I just want to put this whole thing behind me.
If you try to cheat me on this--
Can't you hire someone else to do this?
How'd you find out who was behind the ransom?
Anything you can tell me about the mercs who have your sister?
You're Nassana, right? I ran into your sister, Dahlia. It didn't end well for her.
Never mind.
I don't do this for payment.
Why me?
Tracking the ransom.
Kidnappers
You should have told me.
I don't like being used.
She deserved to die.
I've got a better deal.
Credits won't cut it.
Don't bother.
Fair enough.
It better be.
I ran into your sister.
She is.
I killed her myself.
You wanted your sister dead?
Wait... You wanted your sister dead?
Obviously.
Thank god you're not my sister.
That's some deadly sibling rivalry.
Nice family.
I'm glad you're not my sister.
Looks like we've got an active distress beacon on the planet below, Commander. No message, just a locator signal.
Thank you for dealing with the hostage situation, Commander.
Chairman Burns' death was regrettable, but I trust you did everything you could to save him.
Chairman Burns commended your heroic efforts and credits you with his survival.
Chairman Burns was quite impressed by the way you resolved the situation peacefully.
Your assistance above and beyond formal duties has been noted, Commander. Fifth Fleet out.
Commander, it's good to see you in the area. We've got a situation that requires your expertise.
A group of fanatical biotics have kidnapped the chairman of the Parliament Subcommittee on Transhuman Studies.
Their freighter sustained damage and is dead in space. Get in there and take them down.
Saving him would be my preference, but we must make it clear that these tactics don't work, Commander.
Your top priority is to neutralize the biotics.
The biotics were seen loading equipment onto the freighter.
Expect traps and combat drones. Nothing you can't handle.
They're L2 biotics, and most of them are suffering major side effects from the implants.
The chairman's subcommittee recently denied a request for reparations to all L2 biotics.
Apparently, they'd like the chairman to reconsider.
I know you're under Citadel jurisdiction now, Shepard, but humanity still needs you. Think about it. Fifth Fleet out.
I appreciate you taking the time, Commander.
I'm sending you the last known coordinates of the freighter. Good luck. Fifth Fleet out.
What's the priority on saving the chairman?
What kind of resistance should I expect?
What are the biotics asking for?
I've got other priorities, Admiral. I don't have time for a rescue operation.
Understood, Admiral. I'll see what I can do.
Priority of Chairman
Enemy Strength
Biotics' Demands
I'll check it out.
You can count on me.
Message coming in from the brass at Arcturus. Patching it through.
Normandy? Admiral Hackett here. We're getting reports warning of a marked increase in geth activity in the Skyllian Verge.
Surveillance drones have identified geth outposts on four different planets in the Armstrong Cluster. We need someone to take them out.
Hard to say. They might just be gathering intel on us. Or maybe they're setting up staging grounds for hit and run attacks on human colonies.
Let's hope not. We need someone to investigate this, Shepard.
You may be a Spectre now, Commander, but you're still part of the Alliance. Don't turn your back on us when we need you.
Finding Saren is still your top priority. But you've got experience fighting the geth. You're the logical choice to take out these outposts.
We're transmitting the locations of all known geth outposts in the Armstrong Cluster to the Normandy now. Admiral Hackett out.
We have any idea what they're after?
It could be the first wave of an invasion.
I'm on it, Admiral.
Stopping Saren is a hell of a lot more important than wiping out a few geth outposts.
Any more information?
Or worse.
Message from Admiral Hackett, Commander. Patching it through.
We just received your report. Looks like this geth incursion was bigger than we thought. They were  probably preparing for a major offensive in the system.
We're increasing patrols in the Armstrong cluster to make sure they can't establish another foothold in the region.
Nice job, Shepard. You saved a lot of human lives on this mission. Hackett out.
... general distress call... Sacred Angel medical transport...
...critical system failure... losing power... emergency landing... --gos Rho... repeat... Argos...
Communications failing... life support... emergency transponder... won't last... please hurry.
There is the wreckage. I do not see any survivors, though.
Looks like the signal's coming from that wreckage.
There's the downed ship. This must be the place.
The signal's coming from that downed ship.
There's the wreckage. The signal must be coming from there.
Careful, Shepard. I've got a bad feeling about this.
Careful, Commander. I've got a bad feeling about this.
Geth! It's a trap!
Message coming in, Commander. Big surprise -- the Alliance needs you again.
Admiral Hackett here, Commander. Your helmsman just forwarded your report on Major Kyle.
Shepard? This is Admiral Hackett with Alliance Command. We've got a mission for you.
Major Kyle, your commanding officer at Torfan, has set up a small compound in the Hawking Eta cluster. He's attracted a number of biotic followers.
An Alliance officer named Major Kyle has set up a small compound in the Hawking Eta cluster. He's attracted a number of followers. Mostly biotics.
He's become an outspoken critic of the Alliance, and we believe he's mentally unstable. This could be trouble, Shepard.
Three days ago, we sent two Alliance representatives to meet with him at his compound. They have disappeared. We believe Kyle and his followers killed them.
That compound is a cult, Shepard. They call him 'Father Kyle' now. He's set himself up as some kind of religious leader.
He's not the same man you served under. He feels responsible for all the Alliance soldiers who died at Torfan.
He used to be a model soldier. But something happened to him at Torfan. Too many Alliance soldiers died under his command. He couldn't cope with the guilt.
His psych evaluations showed he couldn't handle the stress of command any more. He was given an honorable discharge and early retirement.
We'd hoped he would get better in time, but we underestimated how far gone he was. Now it looks like it's too late.
Yes. Major Kyle never showed any biotic tendencies himself, though. I think he's just latched onto a group he identifies with.
Many biotics feel marginalized or ostracized by society. Kyle probably sees them as victims who need his protection. And they see him as someone who will fight for them.
Unfortunately ,he's convinced them that the Alliance is somehow responsible for all of their problems. We can't let him go on like this.
They wanted to bring him back to an Alliance facility for treatment. Major Kyle served us faithfully for many years. We weren't going to abandon him.
Given his state of mind, however, he probably saw them as a threat. We're almost certain he had his followers kill them.
You served with him; he might listen to you. But he's already killed two Alliance representatives. I'll trust you to use your judgment. Hackett out.
That may not be possible, Commander. We don't want a bloodbath, but Kyle is dangerous. I'll trust you to use your judgment. Hackett out.
We don't want this to turn into a massacre, Commander. Kyle is dangerous. I trust you to use your judgment. Hackett out.
We never like to see civilian casualties, but I think we all knew how this was going to end. You did what you had to do.
The news vids are going to pick this story up for sure, but we'll keep your name out of it, Shepard. Hackett out.
